# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_SUPPORT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to find support at VWAP when the EMA ribbon is bullish (8EMA > 21EMA > 55EMA), offering a high-probability long entry opportunity. This setup combines VWAP touch-and-go logic with ribbon alignment and RSI filter to capture intraday mean-reversion swings within the prevailing trend, particularly during low-volatility morning sessions.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When SPY price touches VWAP (within 0.1% tolerance) and closes above VWAP on the same 5-minute bar, and the 8EMA > 21EMA > 55EMA (bullish ribbon) for that bar, and RSI(14) > 50, then enter long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop placed at the low of the entry bar (chart-stop), target set at 1.5R. If price reaches 1R, trail stop to break-even then switch to a chandelier trail (ATR×2) for the runner position.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when VIX < 18 and time is between 09:45-11:30 EST; disabled during FOMC windows.
